title: 开源语音识别排行榜新增首个全球南方语言
summary: Hugging Face 的 Open ASR Leaderboard 是一个用于评估开源自动语音识别（ASR）模型的公开排行榜，旨在推动语音技术的透明化和可复现性。近日，该排行榜首次引入了一种来自全球南方（Global South）的语言，这标志着其在语言多样性覆盖上的重要进展。此前，排行榜主要聚焦于英语等资源丰富的语言，而此次新增的语言（具体语言名称未在摘要中提及，但通常指非洲、南亚或东南亚等地区的语言）填补了资源稀缺语言的评估空白。这一举措有助于促进 ASR 模型在低资源语言上的性能提升，并为研究者提供标准化的基准测试。文章可能还讨论了该语言的数据集来源、评估指标（如词错误率）以及参与模型的表现。整体而言，这一更新反映了开源社区对语言包容性和公平性的重视，也为全球南方地区的语音技术应用（如教育、医疗、农业等）提供了更可靠的工具支持。
summary_en: The Open ASR Leaderboard by Hugging Face, a public benchmark for evaluating open-source automatic speech recognition (ASR) models, has added its first language from the Global South. This marks a significant step toward diversifying language coverage, as the leaderboard previously focused on resource-rich languages like English. The inclusion of a low-resource language addresses the evaluation gap for such languages, promoting performance improvements and providing a standardized benchmark for researchers. The article likely discusses the dataset source, evaluation metrics (e.g., word error rate), and model performance. This update reflects the open-source community's commitment to linguistic inclusivity and fairness, supporting speech technology applications in education, healthcare, and agriculture in the Global South.
